hypothesis: A frame chain INSTRUMENT -> WORLD -> FIXTURE -> PART -> CAD with left-perturbation covariances propagates to point uncertainty by first-order adjoints, and the 3-2-1 datum and artifact fits have the linearized covariances their Jacobians predict.
input_data: Declared link covariances (tracker registration 0.010 mm / 5 urad, fixture 0.020 mm / 20 urad, CAD 0.005 mm / 10 urad)
Datum points probed with the tracker (0.015 mm); gauge sphere probed with the CMM (0.002 mm)
mathematical_model: T_true = exp(xi) T; composition C = sum Ad(T_1..T_k-1) C_k Ad^T; point covariance [I, -(Tp)^] C [I, -(Tp)^]^T; 3-2-1 datum: A plane normal z, B direction x, origin on the A, B and C planes; geometric sphere fit; step gauge m = (1 + e) L + b.
numerical_result: Coupon far-corner std (linear) [0.0449, 0.0397, 0.0452] mm; largest link contribution WORLD->FIXTURE (0.0622 mm RSS); datum rotation std [102.6, 117.4, 132.6] urad.
observation_model: Synthetic probing only; no artifact was measured.
